status_effects.explanation: She is depicted as culturally ignorant and petty, undercut by narratorial irony.
His style and flair earn him local admiration despite lacking wealth, paralleling the Guermantes pattern of chic without fortune.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Il paraît qu'elle récite de l'Aristote (elle voulait dire de l'Aristophane) dans le monde. Je ne tolère pas ça chez moi ! »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator ironically reports her malapropism (confusing Aristotle with Aristophanes) and her petty resentment at not being visited by the duchess, portraying her as ignorant and small-minded.

appraisal_events.evidence: Saint-Loup, qui n'avait guère plus que des dettes, éblouissait Doncières par ses attelages
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite having little money, Saint-Loup dazzles the garrison town with his equipages, contrasted with a wealthy Courvoisier who rides only the tram.
